Joice, we are at lesson nineteen. How was it eighteen lessons ago?

And now? What do you do in the meetings?

Asking to repeat is not a problem. What are you doing this month?

Hello. This is a short message about your progress, and it is not an evaluation. Eighteen lessons ago you did not say one sentence in English about your work. Today you tell your career, you ask questions, and you answer them. You are still learning, and that is normal. You are already doing in English what you do in Portuguese every week: you read a report, you ask about the numbers, and you say what you think. In November you are presenting. That is the whole story, in three times.

Hi, this is a message about the next block of the program. Until now we worked on your work, your team and your story. From lesson twenty-one we are going to work on the event itself: the presentation, the questions after it, and the coffee break. Nothing changes in the method: we speak first, and the grammar comes after. If you want to change something in the plan, tell your teacher this week. Thank you, and see you soon.

Joice opens her notebook on Monday morning. She reads the four lines of her introduction again. She remembers that she wrote them in lesson eleven. She says the four lines out loud, without looking. She writes one new line about November.
